title: Wet- and dry-season SMAP analysis increments — DA-SMAP-noCDF, NorthMor, 2016
caption:
Seasonal mean increments during wet and dry seasons. This diagnostic shows whether the assimilation correction depends on seasonal hydroclimatic conditions.
Wet season = Nov, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr
Dry season = May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct
Colorbar limits: robust symmetric bounds [-1.5e-3, 1.5e-3].
